from.place: Proof paragraph 1: subcanonicality of the pro-etale topology used to identify representables with sheaves.

title: Subcanonical pro-etale topology
statement: Let X be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and let X_proetale be its pro-etale site [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site]. The pro-etale topology on X_proetale is subcanonical: for every object V of X_proetale, the presheaf h_V=Hom_X(-,V) is a sheaf of sets.
